{{Top|leg}}
The '''Twi'lek Strutters' Night''' was a type of dance that can be performed while the music [[Torrid Yavin]] is playing.<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Voort saBinring]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], danced on stage at the [[Old Kura City Courthouse Plaza]] during a [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
